QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Deus Ex You
QuestInfo.0: Gilberto said they'd been spending enormous resources fighting the pirates, to no avail. Leon claimed he could get rid of Captain Blood... with your help.
QuestInfo.1: Gilberto said they'd been spending enormous resources fighting the pirates, to no avail. Leon claimed he could get rid of Captain Blood... with your help. Gilberto scolded Leon, concerned about his health, and you thought Gilberto didn't trust Leon to handle things.
QuestInfo.2: Gilberto said they'd been spending enormous resources fighting the pirates, to no avail. Leon claimed he could get rid of Captain Blood... with your help. Gilberto scolded Leon, concerned about his health, then later pulled you aside to ask you to watch over his son.
